title: Trim a Binary Search Tree
summary: Given a binary search tree's root and a range defined by low and high values, remove nodes whose values fall outside this range.
statement: Given a binary search tree's root and a range defined by low and high values, remove nodes whose values fall outside this range. Ensure the tree's structure remains intact for nodes within the range. Return the new root, which may differ based on the specified bounds.
constraints: The input is a BST and low <= high.
Remove values outside the inclusive range while preserving the relative structure of retained nodes.
